task: Vyhľadajte v internetovom obchode ľubovoľnú knihu od Franka Herberta a vložte ju do košíka. Potom vyhľadajte ďalšiu knihu (ktora nemusi byt od Franka Herberta) z sekcie sci-fi a tú tiež vložte do košíka. Nakoniec otvorte košík.

goalSpec.goal: Add a book by Frank Herbert and a sci-fi book to the cart, then open the cart.
successCriteria: The cart contains a book by Frank Herbert.
The cart contains a sci-fi book.
goalSpec.stopCondition: The user has opened the cart.
assumptions: The website contains books by Frank Herbert.
The website has a sci-fi section.
constraints: The process must be completed using the current page layout.

subtasks.title: Search for a book by Frank Herbert.
subtasks.doneWhen: The search results show books by Frank Herbert.

subtasks.title: Add the selected Frank Herbert book to the cart.
subtasks.doneWhen: The cart shows the Frank Herbert book.

subtasks.title: Search for a sci-fi book.
subtasks.doneWhen: The search results show sci-fi books.

subtasks.title: Add the selected sci-fi book to the cart.
subtasks.doneWhen: The cart shows the sci-fi book.

subtasks.title: Open the cart.
subtasks.doneWhen: The user is viewing the cart.
